single.rationale: Extreme Networks shows stabilization after a difficult FY2024 (loss of $86M) with return to positive operating income in FY2025, strong FCF generation ($127M, 11.2% margin), and improving gross margins (62.2% vs 56.5%). However, revenue remains essentially flat over three years ($1.1B) with minimal growth (2% YoY), the company is barely profitable, and faces elongated sales cycles from macro headwinds. The valuation appears reasonable at 18x P/FCF with net cash position, but lacks compelling growth catalysts beyond the new Platform ONE solution.
